creator: Alexander Terp
description: Agent facts (context used, sub-agents, waiting) now reach muster window and --json, but pane wait keys only on state. WatchPanes would carry a condition on facts and a watch would wake on facts as well as state. Useful for an orchestrator that wants to compact a worker before it runs out of context.
title: muster pane wait on an agent fact, such as context over 80%
